name: Throne heavy fighter
note: FS2 reference class; a heavy fighter. Copied for Throne heavy fighter (Earth's side in the dogfight); every fs2 number still names the FS2 ship it came from.

shield.unit: hp (FS2 total over four quadrants; the bubble gets shieldBubbleScale of it)

geometry.about: One box about the hull (wings included); the shield bubble is derived from it like the juice's.

partsSource: hpPercent: a share of the hull, FS2's way (ships.tbl GTF Hercules $Subsystem: engines 35, weapons 10, sensors 10); two engine pods split the engines' share, each gun mount takes the weapons' share
partKindsSource: Parts come from the model (Resources/ShipArt/earth_heavy.ship.json) through the visual adapter; the model's relative part weights scale these. hpPercent is a share of the hull per unit weight: the engines, the sensors and the guns keep the shares the stand-in parts above had (a needle mount is weight 0.5, so the pair makes the old single mount's share; the chin cannon is weight 1); the missile rack is new (8, a rack is as tough as a sensor). The parts above are the stand-ins a headless lab without a model uses; with a model they are replaced.
